faq.question: Is trekking poles allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Trekking Poles is not_allowed in carry-on luggage. Hiking poles and trekking poles are prohibited in carry-on baggage.

faq.answer: Yes, Trekking Poles is allowed in checked bags. Trekking poles and hiking sticks are allowed in checked baggage.
